capital_invested_inr_quote: The founders started the outlet with an initial investment of Rs 3.5 lakh.

own_summary: A beverage retail business established in Bengaluru targeting corporate tech hubs. Operations achieved outlet breakeven in 14 months while recording first-year revenue of 12 lakh INR against initial capital of 3.5 lakh INR.
